quotes.excerpt: Every player that's tear their Achilles average less than what they normally average.
quotes.quote: Whenever you tear your Achilles, you don't -- the only one player to ever do it was Kevin Durant, and it was slightly higher. So if you take Damian Lillard's last year in Milwaukee, it's going to be less than whatever he averaged. Every player that's tear their Achilles average less than what they normally average.
